headline: ISSUE MOMENTUM
headline_accent: VOTER ID AND AI HEAT UP
dek: Online heat, day over day, across 60 issues.

means.label: Online vs. voters:
means.text: Electricity bills & data centers is tied for No. 1 in voter polling (as of Nov. 23) but ranked No. 9 online.

means.label: Comparable days:
means.text: 59 issues had heat Nov. 26, 60 on Nov. 27; 123,588 vs. 130,203 messages.

sources: Whip data: online heat is relative within each day; change compares Nov. 26 and Nov. 27, 2026 (59 and 60 issues; 123,588 and 130,203 messages). Movers limited to issues with at least 500 messages both days. Voter priority from polling as of Nov. 23, 2026. Source: api.whipcampaigns.com/civic, pulled Nov. 28, 2026.
